note: BH-9437: before rebuild-fresh closes a ci-red PR, the resolver stores the failing required check names of its head (.red_sigs) and compares them with the PR before it. The same set twice stops the ladder: no close, no enqueue, one warn alert (id red-repeat:<project>:<key>:<head12>) that names the checks. The PR stays open; a new push restarts the compare. 0 = no red-set compare, as before BH-9437.
